prompt: Which of these is a built-in project automation?
explanation: Built-in automations handle the mechanical state sync — closing an issue or merging a PR can flip its project item to Done. Merges and deletions stay human decisions.

options.text: When an issue in the project closes, its item moves to Done automatically
Auto-deleting closed issues after a week
Auto-merging pull requests assigned to the project
Auto-creating a repository for every draft item
